name: MmmHmm
editorial_article: "MmmHmm" is a landmark track by American producer Flying Lotus, featuring the virtuosic bass playing of frequent collaborator Thundercat. Released in 2010 as part of Flying Lotus's highly influential third studio album, *Cosmogramma*, the track represents a pivotal "astral oasis" within the dense, hyperspeed, and complex cosmic soundscape of the album. Known for its breezy, tropical-tinged melody and intricate production, the song showcases a harmonious convergence between electronic experimentation and live jazz-infused instrumentation.\n\nThe track is widely celebrated for its ability to balance machine-like rhythmic precision with the fluid, "folded-over" bass lines characteristic of Thundercat’s unique style. Lyrically and tonally, the song offers a sense of introspection and clarity, exemplified by the refrain "Just be who you are," which serves as a poignant moment of zen amid the record's broader, more chaotic electronic textures. Culturally, the collaboration solidified the creative partnership between Flying Lotus and Thundercat, a duo whose future work would go on to fundamentally shape the development of experimental hip-hop, electronic music, and modern jazz fusion throughout the 2010s. By standing out as a rare, accessible melodic center within *Cosmogramma*, "MmmHmm" remains one of the most recognizable and enduring compositions from the Warp Records era of Flying Lotus's career.
